SELECT 
  t.id AS task_id,
  t.hire_id,
  t.task_name,
  t.owner,
  t.due_date,
  t.status,
  CURRENT_DATE::date - t.due_date AS days_overdue,
  h.full_name,
  h.hire_type,
  h.manager_id,
  h.preferred_lang
FROM tasks t
JOIN hires h ON h.id = t.hire_id
WHERE t.status = 'pending'
  AND t.due_date < CURRENT_DATE
ORDER BY days_overdue DESC;
